name: Simulation Assault
description: A rapid sequence of dizzying simulations plays throughout the theater.
disable: DC 17 Arcana , DC 17 Nature , DC 17 Occultism , or DC 17 Religion (trained) to siphon the magical energy, or DC 19 Thievery (trained) to disrupt the holograms, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 16)
routine: (1 action) The hazard plays a new simulation each round, forcing all creatures who can sense it to attempt a new save.

defensiveAbilities.name: Accelerated Simulation
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the theater

Effect The trap launches a series of simulations at a dizzying pace, each slightly different from the previous one. All creatures in area B6 who can see must attempt a DC 20 Will Saving Throw save. The trap the rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Sickened 1 for 1 round.

Failure The target takes 2d4 Mental Damage damage and is sickened 1.

Critical Failure The target takes 4d4 Mental Damage damage and is Sickened 2.
